messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Great progress! Your phone now has excellent 5G signal with mobile data enabled. Let's test if MMS is working now.

Please use the **can_send_mms** action to check if your messaging app can send MMS messages. Let me know what it reports.

If it says you can send MMS, you should be able to send picture/video messages successfully. If it says you cannot send MMS, we'll need to check a few more settings (like Wi-Fi Calling status and messaging app permissions).

I checked, and my messaging app can now send MMS messages successfully. It looks like the issue is resolved. Thank you very much for your help!

Is there anything else I should do or check?

Please summarize the next appropriate account action now.
